title: Taiyi v6.3 subscription billing rules

messages.content: You are a product requirements assistant.

For Taiyi v6.3 billing, implement dual mode: monthly membership and pay-as-you-go credits. Membership price: ¥19.9/month, includes 35,000 credits. Extra credits: ¥10 buys 20,000 credits. Free users get 1,000 trial credits, expire in 7 days. Hard rule: never allow negative balance. If balance < estimated_cost, block execution before model call. Refund policy: failed model call refunds 100% credits within 3 seconds. Metrics: recharge conversion >= 8%, monthly churn <= 6%, gross margin target 70%.
Captured billing rules: ¥19.9/month, 35k included, ¥10/20k extra, 1k trial credits, no negative balance, pre-call blocking, failed-call refund within 3 seconds.
